questions.question: 77999. Indication of circumcision:
questions.explain:
In infants and young boys, circumcision is usually performed at the request of the parents for social or religious reasons.

Medical indications for circumcision:

true phimosis
LS (rare under the age of 5 years), recurrent attacks of balanoposthitis recurrent UTIs with abnormalities such as high-grade vesicoureteral reflux.

Circumcision should not be performed in the presence of hypospadias, penile curvature or buried penis.

questions.question: 77980. Chronic suppurative painful skin abscess occuring in axilla, & groin is called as:
questions.explain:
Hidradenitis suppurativa is characterised by follicular occlusion, folliculitis and secondary infection (usually with Staphylococcus aureus and Propionibacterium acnes). It includes painful skin abscesse, sinus tracts and scarring. It affects apocrine gland-bearing skin in the axillae, groins and, less often, scalp, breast, chest and perineum.
